desc: Copy files/folders between a container and the local filesystem
u: docker-cp - Copy files/folders between a container and the local filesystem
docker cp [OPTIONS] CONTAINER:SRC_PATH DEST_PATH|- docker cp [OPTIONS] SRC_PATH|- CONTAINER:DEST_PATH

-a, --archive
[=false] Archive mode (copy all uid/gid information)
-L, --follow-link
[=false] Always follow symbol link in SRC_PATH
-q, --quiet
[=false] Suppress progress output during copy. Progress output is automatically suppressed if no terminal is attached
